name: fulgurlab
description: Unified electronics lab: a TypeScript circuit-simulation engine (ported from circuitjs1) plus fpgasim/mcusim lockstep co-simulation (see docs/bridge-protocol.md)
comment: The npm workspace root is web/ (that is where node_modules lives, and where both packages resolve @fulgurlab/engine from). These scripts delegate into it so `npm test` works from the repository root as well.

scripts.test: npm --prefix web/engine run test && npm --prefix web/app run test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix web/engine run typecheck && npm --prefix web/app run typecheck
